events.title: Lady Gaga tribute by Kery Fay

highlights: Design-led LGBTQ+-friendly market on Friesenplatz (Belgian Quarter): pastel stalls, revolving tree, fountain, daily stage with drag shows, DJs and live acts, XL Glühweinhaus 'Heaven&Hell'.
parking: Parkhaus Maastrichter Straße, Q-Park Rudolfplatz, Ring Karree
train: U-Bahn 3/4/5/12/15 to Friesenplatz (2 stops from Köln Hbf on line 5)

costs.cash: card-only at Glühweinhaus; most huts take cards

crowds: After-work and Fri/Sat nights packed; weekday 14:00-17:00 easiest.

name: Schlossweihnacht auf Schloss Dyck
repBasis: One of the Rhineland's premier castle markets: 140 exhibitors in a moated baroque castle and park with light show and living nativity.
tip: Use the free shuttle from S-Bahn Büttgen/parking and buy tickets online for the December weekends.
highlights: 140 exhibitors around a moated castle and its park, from the Sophorenallee to the castle terrace. There is an evening light show at the Patte d'Oie, a steam train for children, and indoor halls in the Stallhof and Teehaus.
parking: Castle car park; free shuttle every 20 min via Glehn to S-Bahn Büttgen
train: S-Bahnhof Büttgen, then free shuttle bus
crowds: Admission is €18.50 (children 7-16 €3). Opening time on Sunday is calmest; Saturday afternoons and evenings are busiest.

name: Burgweihnacht auf Burg Satzvey
repBasis: Long-running historic market in a fairytale moated castle with a medieval nativity play; among the best-known Eifel castle markets.
tip: Buy timed tickets in advance and wear sturdy shoes for the cobbled courtyard.

events.title: Medieval nativity play (repeats)
events.note: Latin/Middle High German, several shows daily, all weekends

highlights: Fairy-tale moated castle on four Advent weekends: craft stalls, Santa's workshop with elves, boot-filling for kids (Sat to 15:00). Entry €15 adult / €10 child (advance €12/€8), family €40.
parking: Signposted large car parks at village entrances
train: Satzvey station on Köln-Trier line, short walk
crowds: Saturday afternoons sell out; buy advance tickets and go Sunday at opening.

name: Kronenburger Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: One of the most picturesque Eifel markets: 70+ stalls in the lanes of a tiny walled castle village; so busy a shuttle bus runs.
tip: Use the shuttle bus from the outer car parks; Sunday daytime is calmest.
highlights: Tiny walled Eifel village with white half-timbered houses, lit lanes and castle ruin; 70+ craft stalls, a big raffle. Entry €5 (under-13 free).
parking: Event shuttle bus runs all days
train: No rail; car + shuttle bus
crowds: Saturday is very crowded with long shuttle queues; Friday evening or Sunday morning are calmer.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt auf Burg Reifferscheid

name: Weihnachtsmarkt auf Burg Wissem

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Bergisch Gladbach

name: Altenberger Adventsmarkt

name: Burgweihnacht Denklingen

parking: Free parking in the village
train: No rail; buses from Gummersbach/Waldbröl
crowds: Local event; Saturday evening liveliest.

name: Adventsmarkt im Kreismuseum Zons

name: Mönchengladbacher Weihnachtsmarkt

name: Weihnachtsmarkt rund um Schloss Neersen

name: Ratinger Weihnachtsmarkt

highlights: Medieval Advent market (Thu-Sun on all four Advent weekends) in the park of moated Schloss Strünkede / Emschertal-Museum, with craftspeople, jugglers, fire acts and the lit castle facade.
parking: Limited parking at the site; public transport advised on weekends
train: U35 to 'Schloss Strünkede' (from Bochum/Herne)
crowds: Saturday evenings busiest; Thursdays quietest.
dateNote: Dates corrected on 4 Nov (were 2026-12-04 to 2026-12-20).

name: Broicher Schlossweihnacht
repBasis: Medieval-themed Christmas with knights, jesters and craftsmen in a Carolingian-era castle.
tip: Saturday after dark has the best fire-and-torch atmosphere.

events.title: Nativity play in Latin/Middle High German

highlights: Medieval Christmas village in the Carolingian Schloss Broich: campfires, torches, knights, jesters and live crafts (smithing, spinning, bread baking). Paid entry (~€10 adult, unverified).
parking: Limited at castle; P+R via U18 advised
train: Tram/U18 stop Schloß Broich; Mülheim Hbf ~10 min walk
crowds: Saturday evenings after dark busiest; Sunday late morning calmer.

name: Nostalgischer Weihnachtsmarkt Hattingen
repBasis: 150+ stalls in a half-timbered old town; regularly cited among the Ruhr's most beautiful markets.
tip: Weekdays are far calmer; park at the edge and walk in.

events.title: Frau Holle opens town-hall Advent calendar (daily from 1 Dec)

highlights: 150+ stalls in narrow half-timbered lanes around the Old Town Hall and leaning-spire St. Georg; kids' bakery, craftsmen at work, Frau Holle shaking 'gold coins' from a window. Free entry.
parking: Paid parking in town, incl. Advent Sundays
train: S-Bahn Hattingen (Ruhr) Mitte, few min walk
crowds: Weekend late afternoons around the 17:00 Frau Holle show are crush-busy; weekday lunchtimes quiet.

name: Recklinghäuser Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: Sizeable old-town market known for its large ice rink.
tip: Bring skates or rent on site.
highlights: There are two areas: the classic Altstadtmarkt under a large canopy of lights, and Kirchplatz with a nostalgia bar and the charity 'Hütte der guten Taten'. A fairytale forest with readings is in Palais Vest, plus a family stage programme.
train: Recklinghausen Hbf, approx. 10 min walk
crowds: Weekday early afternoons are quiet; Fri/Sat evenings busiest.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Gelsenkirchen City
closedNote: Totensonntag 22 Nov: status not yet published (NRW markets usually close or open only in the evening)
repBasis: Christmas village with Alm hut on the Heinrich-König-Platz; local draw.
tip: Combine with Crange (10 min) the same evening.
highlights: Compact 'Weihnachtsdorf' on Heinrich-König-Platz and Neumarkt between two churches, with an alpine hut, international food, craft huts and a ~10 m tree. In 2025 there was weekend stage music, a puppet theatre on Wednesdays and children's activities on Sundays.
train: Gelsenkirchen Hbf, short walk via Bahnhofstraße
crowds: Weekdays are quiet; weekend late afternoons, when the stage programme runs, are busiest.

name: Wittener Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: Town market on the Rathausplatz; local draw.
tip: Combine with Hattingen (15 min).
highlights: A town-centre market on Rathausplatz with the Witten Christ Child, a children's lantern parade and fairytale huts (Snow White, Santa's elves).
train: Witten Hbf, approx. 10 min walk
crowds: Weekday afternoons are quiet; Saturday evenings busiest.

name: Hagener Weihnachtsmarkt
closedNote: Totensonntag (22 Nov) closed; closed 24-27 Dec, reopens 28-30 Dec
repBasis: 57th edition; city-centre market with Ferris wheel.
tip: Visit the LWL open-air museum market (27-29 Nov) on the same trip.
highlights: 57th edition spread from Friedrich-Ebert-Platz (Ferris wheel) through Hohenzollernstraße to the Volkspark, with a 30 m light tunnel, walk-in bauble and stage.
parking: Otto-Ackermann-Platz car park; P+R buses (2025)
train: Hagen Hbf, ~10 min walk
crowds: Friday and Saturday evenings busiest; weekday early afternoons quiet.

name: Romantischer Weihnachtsmarkt im LWL-Freilichtmuseum Hagen
repBasis: 80+ exhibitors among illuminated half-timbered workshops in the Mäckingerbach valley open-air museum.
tip: Saturday after dark is magical; expect parking queues - use the shuttle if offered.
highlights: 80+ hand-picked exhibitors among the lit half-timbered workshops of an open-air museum in a wooded valley. Live choirs, orchestras, alphorns and Christmas jazz play throughout.
parking: Museum car park, Selbecker Str. 200
train: Hagen Hbf, then bus to Freilichtmuseum
crowds: Saturday is busiest. Buy €8 tickets online (on sale from 1 Nov) to avoid queues at the gate.

name: Unnaer Weihnachtsmarkt
closedNote: Totensonntag 22 Nov: status not yet published (NRW markets usually close or open only in the evening)
repBasis: Family market across three squares with a Kasperle puppet theatre running since 1976.
tip: Pair with the Centre for International Light Art in Unna.
highlights: An EECMA-listed family market across Rathausplatz, Bahnhofstraße and Marktplatz with about 60 traders. The Kasperle puppet theatre (since 1976) plays daily 15:00-17:15 from 24 Nov. New in 2026 is 'Unterm Turm' with a Glühwein pyramid and ice curling.
parking: Parkhaus Neue Mühle (Kantstr. 5, 316 spaces) next to the market
train: Unna Bf, short walk via Bahnhofstraße
crowds: Weekday mornings are calm; Kasperle hours and weekend evenings are busiest.
dateNote: Dates confirmed in the 4 Nov check.

name: Lichtermarkt im Tobiaspark
closedNote: Totensonntag 22 Nov: status not yet published (NRW markets usually close or open only in the evening)
repBasis: Medieval-style market with fire bowls and torches in a town park.
tip: Best after dark.
highlights: A young medieval-style market (premiered 2025) in Tobiaspark with fire bowls, torches, hand-forged goods and weekend folk/shanty music.
crowds: Weekend evenings, when there is stage music, are busiest.

name: Hammer Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: 53rd edition: hut village around the Pauluskirche with ice rink and curling.
tip: Combine with Soest (25 min).

name: Weihnachtsmarkt im Maximilianpark
repBasis: Weekend market in and around a former colliery hall in the Maximilianpark, with the walk-in Glass Elephant.
tip: Climb the Glaselefant for the view.
dateNote: Dates confirmed on 4 Nov

name: Soester Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: ~100 stalls amid green-sandstone churches and half-timbered houses; widely rated one of Germany's most beautiful.
tip: Hear the evening tower-bell melodies; visit the Westphalian nativity in St. Patrokli from 2nd Advent.

name: Winterglanz Bad Sassendorf
repBasis: Almost 60 huts and historic children's rides across three squares and the spa park.
tip: Thu-Sun only; 5 min from Soest, so do both together.

name: Lippstädter Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: 27-day market around the town hall and St. Mary's church with covered ice rink and giant Advent calendar.
tip: Combine with Soest (25 min).

name: Warendorfer Weihnachtswäldchen
repBasis: Distinctive "little Christmas forest" of real fir trees filling the historic market square.
tip: Late afternoon when the trees are lit is best.

name: Adventsmarkt am Wasserschloss Raesfeld
repBasis: Four-day Advent market in the courtyard of a Renaissance moated castle; draws visitors from far afield.
tip: Go Thursday or Friday to avoid weekend crowds.
highlights: Four-day market in the lit courtyard of the Renaissance moated castle Raesfeld, with handmade decorations, carousel, Advent angel and Santa for kids. Entry €7 (€6 presale in Raesfeld), kids to 14 free.
train: No rail; car recommended
crowds: Saturday afternoon/evening busiest; Thursday 15:00 quietest.

name: Bocholter Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: Market around the Renaissance town hall with its illuminated Advent-calendar facade.
tip: Close to the Dutch border; easy via A3.
highlights: 18th edition on the Markt in front of the historic town hall (lit as an Advent calendar), extending along Neustraße, Nordstraße and Neutorplatz. Ice rink on St.-Georgs-Platz; free entry.
train: Bocholt station, ~15 min walk to Markt
crowds: Saturdays busiest (many Dutch day-trippers); weekday early afternoons quiet.

name: Ahauser Schlosszauber
repBasis: Curated design and craft market inside and around Ahaus's baroque palace, with ice rink in the courtyard.
tip: Last-minute gift option on the 4th Advent weekend.
highlights: Baroque moated prince-bishop's palace (1690-1720) with ~50 exhibitors in the courtyard, ground-floor rooms and garden; free ice rink in the courtyard.
parking: Car parks at the castle and town edge
train: Ahaus station, ~5 min walk
crowds: Saturday afternoon busiest; Friday after opening is calmest.
dateNote: Dates confirmed in the 4 Nov check.

name: Hobbykünstler-Weihnachtsmarkt Burg Lüdinghausen
repBasis: About 50 hobby-artist stalls inside a historic moated castle.
tip: Pair with Lüdinghausen's town Advent market (5 Dec) or Burg Vischering.
highlights: One-day hobby-artists market with ~50 makers (jewellery, woodwork, felt, sewing) inside the moated Burg Lüdinghausen; free entry.
crowds: Late morning to early afternoon busiest; arrive at 10:00.

name: Tecklenburger Nikolausmarkt
repBasis: Market spread through the lanes of a picturesque hilltop half-timbered town up to the castle ruins.
tip: Steep cobbles - wear good shoes.
dateNote: Dates confirmed on 4 Nov

name: Bielefelder Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: 110+ huts across the Alter Markt, Jahnplatz and Altstädter Kirchplatz in OWL's largest city.
tip: Start at the Alter Markt with its gabled houses.

name: Bad Salzufler Weihnachtstraum
repBasis: Spa-town market among half-timbered houses and the salt-works (Gradierwerk), often listed among Germany's prettiest.
tip: Walk the Gradierwerk brine walls in the spa park between stalls.

name: Herforder Weihnachtsmarkt
closedNote: NRW Tourism lists daily incl. 24-26 Dec; verify holiday hours
repBasis: Several themed squares (Ravensberger heaven gate, Place of Angels, 1001 Nights) across the old town.
tip: Combine with Bad Salzuflen (15 min).

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Wiedenbrück
repBasis: Half-timbered market square turned "town of lights"; regularly called one of OWL's most beautiful.
tip: Ride the nostalgic carousel; best at dusk.

name: Gütersloher Weihnachtsmarkt
closedNote: Listing shows daily to 30 Dec; verify 24-26 Dec
repBasis: Downtown market with light installations, curling rink and stage programme.
tip: Combine with Wiedenbrück (15 min).

name: Paderborner Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: Main OWL cathedral-city market around the town hall and cathedral.
tip: See the cathedral's "Three Hares" window.

name: Weihnachtszauber im Schlosspark Neuhaus
repBasis: Weekend market at the Weser-Renaissance Schloss Neuhaus and its baroque garden.
tip: Combine with the Paderborn city market.

name: Weihnachtlicher Zauber an der Burg
repBasis: Small lit market at a castle ruin in the spa town.
tip: Combine with Paderborn (15 min).

name: MuseumsAdvent im LWL-Freilichtmuseum Detmold
repBasis: Advent market in Germany's largest open-air museum, with lit historic houses, craft demonstrations and brass music.
tip: Pair with Bad Salzuflen or Detmold old town the same weekend.

name: Höxteraner Weihnachtszauber
repBasis: Market in Höxter's half-timbered Weser old town, near UNESCO-listed Corvey.
tip: Visit Corvey Abbey (UNESCO) nearby.

name: Mindener Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: Market on the historic Marktplatz and Scharn by the cathedral in the Weser city.
tip: Long drive - pair with Petershagen (1st Advent).

name: Weihnachtsmarkt am Schloss Petershagen
repBasis: 40+ exhibitors at a Weser-Renaissance castle on the Weser.
tip: Free castle tours have been offered at 11 and 12.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Schloss Benkhausen
repBasis: Fourth-Advent castle market at a manor that also houses the German Vending Machine Museum.
tip: Far (~3h) - only worth it combined with Minden.

name: Siegener Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: South Westphalia's largest market around the Unteres Schloss, with ice rink and historic Ferris wheel.
tip: Weekdays open only from 16:00.
highlights: Spread from the station along Bahnhofstraße and Scheinerplatz towards the Unteres Schloss. Its landmark is the two-storey 'Bergstation' bar hut, and it has a 'Krönchendorf' area.
train: Siegen Hbf, approx. 10 min walk (RE9, RB93/95)
crowds: Weekday openings at 16:00 are quiet; Friday and Saturday evenings at the Bergstation are packed.
dateNote: Dates confirmed on 11 Nov

name: Historischer Weihnachtsmarkt Olpe
repBasis: Long-standing "historical" market on the Marktplatz with a wide crafts offer.
tip: Thu-Sun on two weekends only.

highlights: A historic-style village on the market square laid with fir branches, wood chips and straw bales. A big tavern has a bonfire, and the stage has music, jugglers and fire shows. Many stalls are run by charities and schools.
train: Olpe station, short walk
crowds: Thursday afternoons are quietest; Saturday evenings busiest.

name: Historischer Weihnachtsmarkt Lüdenscheid
repBasis: Second-Advent market in the old town around the Erlöserkirche.
tip: One weekend only.
highlights: Three-day historic market around the Erlöserkirche in the old town (Altstadtverein with CVJM), several dozen wooden stalls; 6 Dec is also a shopping Sunday (13-18). Free entry.
parking: Parkhaus Stern, then walk to old town
train: Lüdenscheid station, ~10 min walk
crowds: Saturday evening busiest; Sunday morning quiet.
dateNote: Dates confirmed in the 4 Nov check.

name: ChristkindchenMarkt Leverkusen
closedNote: Totensonntag 22 Nov: status not yet published (NRW markets usually close or open only in the evening); 24-26 Dec closure assumed
repBasis: Wiesdorf pedestrian-zone market with curling lanes; mostly a local draw.
tip: Easy stop en route to Cologne's Bensberg/Altenberg markets.
highlights: Pedestrian-zone market in Wiesdorf between Rathaus-Galerie and the shops, 60+ stalls plus club-run social huts and ice-curling lanes; Glühwein huts open to 22:00.
parking: Luminaden garage directly under the market (Q-Park)
train: Leverkusen-Mitte (S6, RE1, RE5), ~5 min walk
crowds: After-work hours and Saturdays busiest; weekday late mornings quiet.
dateNote: Dates confirmed in the 4 Nov check.

name: Arnsberger Weihnachtsmarkt
repBasis: Old-town market in the Sauerland's historic hill town below the castle ruins; regional draw.
tip: Walk up to the Glockenturm and castle ruins for the view.
